slides.title: Auto shop horror stories (October edition)
slides.body: no zombies. just paperwork. (swipe if you dare)

slides.label: Story 1
slides.title: The fleet client asks for your certificate of insurance.
slides.body: You send it. They reply: "this expired last month."

slides.label: Story 2
slides.title: The renewal notice went to the service writer who quit in March.

slides.label: Story 3
slides.title: A customer asks if you're licensed. You point at the wall.
slides.body: The date on the frame is from two years ago.

slides.label: Story 5
slides.title: "Who renewed the business license last year?"
Sleep well tonight.
slides.body: Your renewal dates aren't in the junk drawer. Right? Save this before your next renewal.
